title: Ebb Tide Fishing Charters, LLC
blurb: Guests fish for Striped Bass and other species on the middle Chesapeake Bay from mid-April through December. The operator provides safe and enjoyable offshore fishing adventures with guidance for newcomers. The business operates from two locations: Happy Harbor Inn in Deale and Podickory Point in Annapolis.
